style.summary: Hevy is a white, list-first tracker: near-black text, grey #F3F4F8 secondary buttons and white cards with 1 pt #EDEDED borders. One blue, #267EE8, covers main buttons, links, selected chips and every chart. Done sets turn light green #C7FEA0, and store shots stack heavy all-caps headlines over a blue band.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: 17 pt side margins; routine cards hold a title, a 2-line grey summary and a full-width blue button.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Buttons are about 40 pt tall with 10 pt corners; cards round at about 8 pt; chips and bars are full pills.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: White #FFFFFF screens, black #000000 text, blue #267EE8 for main buttons, links and charts; done sets fill #C7FEA0 with a #56BD23 check.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: Inter ExtraBold 800 caps set store headlines; SemiBold 600 sets titles; Regular 400 sets 16 pt rows and grey sublines.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: Exercise rows show grey 3D figures with red target muscles on 4 of 8 shots; avatars are round photos, 88 pt on profiles.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: Set rows with previous, kg, reps and a 25 pt check box; blue line and bar charts; 12.5 pt round-ended comparison bars.

screenshots.alt: Headline “Log workouts, get stronger, stay motivated” in black and blue capitals, over an Apps We Love badge with 5 stars on a blue band
The Hevy logo over a tilted phone logging Bench Press (Barbell): 1h 15min, 6,800 kg, 18 sets, with 3 finished sets lifted out in green
Headline “Analyze your workouts” above the Squat (Barbell) page: a 3D model with the quads in red and a Heaviest Weight chart that climbs to 80 kg
Headline “Plan your routines” above the Workout tab: Start Empty Workout, New Routine, Explore and 2 saved routines with blue Start Routine buttons
Headline “Join a growing community” above a feed post by strongdavid: Chest Day, 44 min, 5,340 kg, 8 likes and 3 comments
Headline “Track measurements” above progress photos from 4 Feb 2022 and 6 Feb 2024 and a body weight chart that falls to 86 kg
Headline “Compare your strength” above jaumeros vs strongdavid on Bench Press: jaumeros is marked Stronger, with a one rep max of 93 kg vs 80 kg
Headline “Follow friends’ progress” above strongdavid’s profile: 56 workouts, 72 followers, 55 following, a blue Follow button and 3 hours this week
Hevy plan picker: Pro Monthly $2.99, Pro Yearly $23.99 picked, Pro Lifetime $74.99, and a blue Get Started button
Hevy Free and Pro table: 6 features, with Free capped at 4 routines and 7 custom exercises, then the cancel terms

ourRead: Yearly comes preselected at $23.99, or $2.00 a month: 33% under 12 months of the $2.99 Monthly, 50% under the App Store’s $3.99 Monthly.
Lifetime, $74.99, costs as much as 3.1 years of Yearly. It sits right under the selected plan and makes $23.99 look small.
Free logs unlimited workouts but stops at 4 routines, 7 custom exercises and 3 months of graphs. Pro lifts those caps and adds Hevy Trainer.
stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Hevy's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% white #FFFFFF: every screen and card; secondary buttons #F3F4F8; borders #EDEDED.
- 30% black #000000: titles, values and icons; secondary text #86898E.
- 10% bright blue #267EE8: main buttons, links, selected chips, the active tab, charts.
- Done states: row #C7FEA0, check box #56BD23.
Type:
- Headlines: Inter 800 caps for heroes; Inter 600 at about 18 pt for titles.
- Body: Inter 400, 16 pt rows, 13 pt grey sublines; tabular numbers.
Shapes:
- Buttons 40 pt tall with 10 pt corners; cards 8 pt corners with a 1 pt #EDEDED border; chips and bars are full pills.
Layout:
- 17 pt side margins; lists sit in bordered white cards.
Components:
- Routine card: title, a 3-dot menu, 2-line grey summary, full-width blue button.
- Set row: previous, kg, reps and a 25 pt check box; a done row turns #C7FEA0.
- Charts: thin blue line with dot markers, or blue bars on light grid lines.
Icons and imagery:
- Outline icons in black; grey 3D muscle figures with red target muscles.
Check:
- Blue marks every main button, link and chart.
- Every screen background is white.
- Buttons are 40 pt tall with 10 pt corners.
